definitions.explanation: Making things by hand, especially as a school activity or hobby. Also refers to engineering or construction work in technical contexts.
Covert or strategic activities to influence outcomes, especially in political or organizational settings.

notes:
USAGE:
Sense 1 is very common in elementary school contexts, where {工作|こうさく} refers to arts-and-crafts activities. The school subject is called {図画|ずが}{工作|こうさく} (art and crafts), often abbreviated to ⟦{図工|ずこう}→図工：19698_zukou⟧. Sense 2 has a negative connotation, implying covert or underhanded activity.
